answer: Each agent can earn transaction privileges only after locking a scarce deposit that is slashed if independent audits find fabricated identities or collusion. Auditors sample signed work and compare funding, timing, and counterparties, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply the value of the same stake. A voyage may yield a pearl, but reaching the jetty still requires capital at risk: the attacker must tie up funds in every identity and can lose them when exposed.
